newsitem.title: USA: Cisco Q1 profit narrowly tops estimates.
newsitem.headline: Cisco Q1 profit narrowly tops estimates.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc Tuesday said fiscal first-quarter profits from operations rose 77 percent, slightly better than Wall Street expected, on strong sales of its computer networking equipment.

Cisco, the world's biggest maker of networking devices, said operating profits for the quarter ended October 26 rose to $320.8 million, or $0.47 a share, from $181.4 million, or $0.28, in the same quarter a year ago.

With a $174.6 million charge for the acquisition of Telebit Corp and a $55.1 million gain from the sale of a minority investment, net income for the quarter totaled $180.9 million, or $0.26 cents a share.
Wall Street expected Cisco, based in San Jose, Calif., to report profit from operations of $0.46, according to a survey by research firm First Call.
Cisco said first-quarter revenue jumped 80 percent to $1.43 billion from $798.3 million.
Cisco said strong sales across all its product lines contributed to the earnings increase. -- Kourosh Karimkhany, in Los Angeles, + 1 800 330 NEWS
